beats.headline: Out of a gold pet box
beats.text: In the gold pet box, Donut receives a black, magical collar for Mongo that places his orange dot on the map wherever he is. Mongo screams and tries to rip it off. After a few admonishments from Donut he relents and stops scratching at it.

beats.headline: A boa on the collar
beats.text: Katia and Donut come back from the Desperado Club, where they spent the whole two hours of the storm, Katia with a feather boa round her neck. Mongo is loose too, and he has a boa of his own, dangling from his collar. He keeps snapping at it, and feathers fly everywhere. Donut and Katia went into the Penis Parade together.
